headline: Budsquire Best Build
title: Budsquire Build | Thorny counter plan | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Budsquire is a Grass melee Aniimo with only two skills, so use both. Thorny Defense puts it in a defensive stance that cuts damage and counters when hit. If you get attacked right as you cast it, your crit rate goes up. Thorny Impact thrusts forward and also raises crit rate on hit. Block first, then thrust while crit is high. Does Budsquire make your team? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Crit rate rises if hit on cast

description: Aniimo Budsquire build: Thorny Defense counters and boosts crit when timed well, then Thorny Impact keeps crit rate high.
